name: What are common signs that my toilet needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my toilet needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs your toilet needs repair include continuous running, weak or incomplete flushing, leaks around the base, and unusual noises like gurgling or whistling. A running toilet can waste significant water, while a weak flush might indicate issues with the flapper, fill valve, or siphon jet. Leaks often point to a failing wax ring or loose tank bolts. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage and higher water bills. If you notice any of these symptoms, it's best to have a professional diagnose the problem to ensure a proper and lasting repair. This proactive approach helps maintain your plumbing system's efficiency and prevents minor issues from escalating into major emergencies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include a continuously running toilet, weak flushing, leaks around the base, and strange noises. These indicate issues with internal components or seals.
